secret.description: Secret key used for API key HMAC signing.

secret_length.description: Length of generated API key secrets.
secret_length.title: Secret Length

admin_client_id.description: Keycloak OIDC client ID for admin users.
admin_client_id.title: Admin Client Id

invoice_process_interval_seconds.description: Interval in seconds for processing invoices in the management service
invoice_process_interval_seconds.title: Invoice Process Interval Seconds

transaction_expire_check_interval_second.description: Interval in seconds for checking and closing expired transactions
transaction_expire_check_interval_second.title: Transaction Expire Check Interval Seconds

cache_limit.description: Maximum number of cached conversations per user.
cache_limit.title: Cache Limit

pgvector_connection_uri.description: PostgreSQL connection URI for the pgvector database.
pgvector_connection_uri.title: Pgvector Connection Uri

cache_ttl.description: Cache time-to-live, None mean never expire
cache_ttl.title: Cache Ttl

server_url.description: Keycloak base URL reachable by the backend. This is also used as the fallback public URL when public_server_url is not configured.
server_url.title: Server Url

public_server_url.description: Public Keycloak base URL exposed to browsers and used by OpenAPI OAuth flows.
public_server_url.title: Public Server Url

issuer_url.description: Expected JWT issuer URL. Configure this when Keycloak tokens use a public hostname that differs from server_url.
issuer_url.title: Issuer Url

jwks_url.description: JWKS URL used by the backend to fetch signing keys. Configure this when issuer_url is public but keys should be fetched over the cluster/internal network.
jwks_url.title: Jwks Url

service_client_id.description: Service account client id for Keycloak Admin API calls.
service_client_id.title: Service Client Id

service_client_secret.title: Service Client Secret

api_key.description: Should be in .env instead of toml
api_key.title: Api Key

context_window.description: Model's context window. Used for AGUI message trimming.
context_window.title: Context Window

s3_bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name for file storage.
s3_bucket_name.title: S3 Bucket Name

s3_region_name.description: AWS region for the S3 bucket.
s3_region_name.title: S3 Region Name

s3_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID for S3.
s3_access_key_id.title: S3 Access Key Id

s3_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key for S3.
s3_secret_access_key.title: S3 Secret Access Key

s3_presigned_url_expiry_seconds.description: Presigned URL expiry time in seconds.
s3_presigned_url_expiry_seconds.title: S3 Presigned Url Expiry Seconds

redis_cache_expiry_seconds.description: Redis cache expiry for file metadata in seconds.
redis_cache_expiry_seconds.title: Redis Cache Expiry Seconds

prometheus_port.description: Port for the Prometheus metrics endpoint.
prometheus_port.title: Prometheus Port

invite_client_id.description: Keycloak public client id used for invitation registration links and post-accept redirects.
invite_client_id.title: Invite Client Id

invite_redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI used for invitation registration links.
invite_redirect_uri.title: Invite Redirect Uri

default_rate_limit.description: Global default rate-limit (requests/min). Individual orgs can override this.
default_rate_limit.title: Default Rate Limit

deletion_cancel_window_days.description: How many days an org deletion request can be canceled before hard deletion.
deletion_cancel_window_days.title: Deletion Cancel Window Days

deletion_worker_interval_seconds.description: Background worker interval for processing due deletions.
deletion_worker_interval_seconds.title: Deletion Worker Interval Seconds

embedding_model.description: Model to use for generating embeddings.
embedding_model.title: Embedding Model

embedding_openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for RAG functionality.
embedding_openai_api_key.title: Embedding Openai Api Key

embedding_openai_base_url.description: Base URL for the OpenAI API.
embedding_openai_base_url.title: Embedding Openai Base Url

reranker_model.description: Model to use for re-ranking RAG results. This can be the same as the embedding model or a different one optimized for ranking.
reranker_model.title: Reranker Model

reranker_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for the re-ranker model.
reranker_api_key.title: Reranker Api Key

reranker_base_url.description: Base URL for the OpenAI API for the re-ranker model.
reranker_base_url.title: Reranker Base Url

supported_langs.description: List of supported languages for bm25 separated by commas. For example: 'simple,english,french'.  The 'lang' field in RagData can only take values from this list.
supported_langs.title: Supported Langs

embedding_batch_size.description: Batch size for generating embeddings. Larger batch sizes can improve throughput but may increase memory usage.
embedding_batch_size.title: Embedding Batch Size

rag_store_half_precision.description: Whether to use half-precision (float16) for storing embeddings in the RAG store. This can reduce memory usage and improve performance on compatible hardware, but may lead to slightly lower accuracy.
rag_store_half_precision.title: Rag Store Half Precision

rag_store_dimension.description: Dimensionality of the vector embeddings stored in the RAG store.
rag_store_dimension.title: Rag Store Dimension

rag_store_index_type.description: Type of vector index to use for the RAG store.

rag_store_index_params_hnsw_m.description: HNSW index parameter 'm', which controls the number of bi-directional links created for each new element during index construction.
rag_store_index_params_hnsw_m.title: Rag Store Index Params Hnsw M

rag_store_index_params_hnsw_ef_construct.description: HNSW index parameter 'ef_construction', which controls the accuracy/speed trade-off during index construction. Higher values lead to better recall but slower indexing.
rag_store_index_params_hnsw_ef_construct.title: Rag Store Index Params Hnsw Ef Construction

rag_store_index_params_ivfflat_lists.description: IVFFlat index parameter 'lists', which determines the number of Voronoi cells (or clusters) used in the index. More lists can improve recall but may increase search time.
rag_store_index_params_ivfflat_lists.title: Rag Store Index Params Ivfflat Lists

rag_store_ops_type.description: Type of vector operations to use for similarity search in the RAG store.

loki_url.description: Loki server URL for user activity logs.
loki_url.title: Loki Url

allowed_origins.description: CORS allowed origins. Use '*' to allow all.
allowed_origins.title: Allowed Origins

host.description: Host address to bind the server to.
host.title: Host

port.description: Port for the public-facing main application.
port.title: Port

internal_port.description: Port for the internal API and metrics.
internal_port.title: Internal Port

log_level.description: Minimum log level for the application.

apikey.description: API key generation and validation settings.
